meta.description: The third season of Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu.

videos.title: Burn Bright, Mad Dog
videos.overview: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.

videos.title: Howl, Mad Dog
videos.overview: Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.

videos.title: Life Back at Home
videos.overview: Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.

videos.title: A King-Class Water Mage
videos.overview: Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.

videos.title: Celebrations
videos.overview: Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.

videos.title: Another Domestic Disaster?
videos.overview: Rudeus accompanies Roxy on a bodyguard mission and runs into an unexpected face from his past.

videos.title: Phase Four
videos.overview: Following a successful summoning experiment, Nanahoshi offers Rudeus a reward.

videos.title: The Flying Fortress
videos.overview: Rudeus seeks an audience with the hero Perugius, hoping to find a cure for his mother's condition.

videos.title: Lament
videos.overview: Nanahoshi contracts an ancient disease. Seeing her lose hope, Rudeus races to find help.

videos.title: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
videos.overview: Rudeus and friends locate Kishirika, only to be captured along with her by the guards of a warlike Demon King.

videos.title: Turning Point 4
videos.overview: Rudeus receives a puzzling message in his dreams. But before he can act on it, a strange visitor appears.

videos.title: An End and a Beginning
videos.overview: Rudeus's strange guest recounts his future and reveals the cause of all his misfortunes.

videos.title: The Diary
videos.overview: In a future that could have been, Rudeus crumbles under the weight of loss.

videos.title: Resolve
videos.overview: Having read one possible future, Rudeus takes action to avoid it and protect the people he loves.
